### Test the Spirits
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/test-spirits
Passage: 1 John 4:1
Points:
- Scripture is God-breathed and serves as the ultimate benchmark for correcting and testing beliefs.
- Believers cannot accept every teacher uncritically, as many false prophets make claims in the world.
- John highlights confession of Christ's incarnation as an essential doctrinal test of orthodoxy.
- Discernment requires examining teaching against the full scope of foundational biblical doctrines.
- Because deception can enter the church, Christians must faithfully study theology to recognize error.

### Who Is Jesus?
Author: John Duncan
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/who-jesus
Passage: 1 John 4:1-6
Points:
- Conflicting answers to the question of Jesus' identity have caused division since the apostolic era.
- Early false prophets distorted the truth by denying that God truly came in human flesh.
- Scripture consistently upholds Jesus as both fully God and genuinely incarnate.
- Modern voices continue to offer misleading portraits of Christ that dilute the gospel.
- Christians can overcome false teaching because the Spirit within them is greater than worldly deception.
